scientific_question: Can one deployment-visible, geometry-preconditioned PCGLS step in the frozen affine coordinate space recover the v179 observable inverse with fewer exact A/A^T calls than physical K4, after the fixed geometry-only rank-16 inverse failed in v181?
role: post-open mechanism diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p22-s01 frames; it is a deterministic classical control, not a learned predictor or a fresh generalization result
physical_distinction: v182 does not change v181 rank, eigenvectors, eigenvalue scoring, ridge, or spectral truncation. It discards the failed fixed rank-16 action and uses the current observation to choose the unique exact line-minimizing step along the geometry-Jacobi-preconditioned adjoint direction.

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, parent-array, operator, adjoint, numerator, denominator, breakdown, observation-only, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v182 inconclusive.
If affine_jacobi_pcgls1 K0 or K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_JACOBI_PCGLS1_V182 and close this one-step diagonal-preconditioned coordinate mechanism.
If the primary passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_JACOBI_PCGLS1_V182.
If the primary passes five-camera but fails all-nine, conclude FAIL_VARIABLE_CARDINALITY_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_JACOBI_PCGLS1_V182.
If any inherited cheaper v181 control passes both sensor arms, reject the primary advantage and prefer that control.
Only if K0 and K1 pass both sensor arms while all inherited cheaper controls remain failed may v182 conclude PASS_OBSERVATION_ADAPTIVE_JACOBI_PCGLS1_HEADROOM_V182.

No v182 outcome is a learned algorithm, external generalization result, end-to-end exact-call reduction result, wall/RSS result, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
